jobs: index the extract kinds by their id
list the pivot caches that hold rows
turn a sheet name into a file stem
give an extract its title
build an item's note from its cut
publish the extract functions on the page
summary: Finishes the extract module's setup by building the id index of kinds, the list of pivot caches with rows, the naming and note helpers, and a test for hidden sheets, then publishes the public functions on the page. The helpers read a workbook or an extract record and return a value, so the only change this part makes is to what it publishes.

jobs: flatten a spreadsheet sheet into a cell list
record a sheet's merged ranges and used area
summary: Takes a parsed sheet and its name and returns the sheet name, its used area, its merged ranges, and one entry per populated cell with the address, formula text and value as text. A follower cell of a shared formula carries a marker naming the master formula instead of its own text.

jobs: describe a conditional format style as text
flag a style id the file lacks
summary: Takes a workbook and a style id and returns a comma-separated list of the fill, text colour, emphasis and border that style sets. An empty id gives an empty string. An id the file does not define gives a bare reference to that id, which is kept apart from a style that sets nothing and so gives an empty string.

jobs: export a sheet's cells as indented json
count the filled formula cells
summary: Takes a sheet and its name and returns one part holding the serialized sheet as indented JSON. Its note says how many cells carry a filled formula, and it is empty when there are none.

jobs: list every formula cell with its value
count shared formula followers
summary: Takes a sheet and the workbook and returns one row per formula cell, giving its address, row, column letter, formula text and value. A shared-formula follower stores no text of its own, so its formula is left empty and the note gives how many such cells there are.

jobs: list the visible formatting of each cell
skip cells with no resolvable style
summary: Takes a sheet and the workbook and returns one row per cell whose style can be resolved, with its font, size, emphasis, colour, fill, alignment, wrapping, indent, drawn border sides and number format. The border is reported as the list of sides that are drawn rather than as its full record.

jobs: list a sheet's merged cell ranges
summary: Takes a sheet and returns its merged ranges as one table with a row for each, the row itself built by the mapping step below. The table is empty when the sheet has no merges.

jobs: describe one merged range as a row
summary: Takes one merged range and returns its address, its top-left cell, its row and column counts, and the value in that top-left cell. The value is null when the sheet data has no row for that cell.

jobs: list a sheet's cell comments
summary: Takes a workbook and a sheet name and returns one row per comment, holding its cell, author and text.

jobs: list a sheet's data validation rules
summary: Takes a workbook and a sheet name and returns one row per data validation rule on that sheet, with each row built by the mapping step below.

jobs: describe one validation rule as a row
summary: Takes one validation rule and returns its cell, span, kind, title, text and allowed options. The options are joined into one string so that a choice list reads as a single value rather than a nested list.

jobs: list a sheet's conditional format rules
sort the rules by priority
summary: Takes a sheet and the workbook and returns its conditional format rules in priority order, with a note that they are shown as written and not evaluated. Whether a rule fires on any given cell is not decided here.

jobs: describe one conditional format rule as a row
summary: Takes one conditional format rule and returns its ranges as addresses, along with its type, operator, priority, stop flag, text, formulas and format label. Several ranges are joined with spaces, and a single cell is shown as one address.

jobs: count the populated columns of a sheet
summary: Takes a sheet and returns how many distinct columns hold at least one cell across all of its rows. A column is counted once however many rows use it.

jobs: export the cached rows of each pivot cache
summary: Takes the workbook and a row limit and returns one part for each pivot cache that has rows, each built by the mapping step below with that limit applied.

jobs: read the rows of one pivot cache
name a cache by its source range
note a mismatch in record counts
summary: Takes the name of one pivot cache and returns its rows up to the limit, its total record count and whether the rows were cut. The label is the source sheet and range where known, and a note is added when the cache's declared record count differs from the rows it holds.

jobs: list the data query sections of a workbook
summary: Takes the parsed workbook and returns one part for each data query section, each built by the mapping step below.

jobs: export one data query's source as text
summary: Takes one query section and returns its label, which is the last part of its path, its source text and the file extension for that query language. A query with no source text gives an empty body rather than an error.

jobs: profile each column of a sheet
summary: Takes a sheet, the workbook and a header row number, which defaults to row 1, and returns one profile row per column. A header row of zero or null is passed on as no header row.

jobs: summarize one column's contents as a row
summary: Takes one column profile and returns a flat row with its letter, header, role, kind, filled, blank, computed and distinct counts, minimum and maximum, and up to four most common values with their counts. A missing minimum or maximum is left empty.

jobs: report each sheet's content counts
count workbook-wide content kinds
list the available content kinds
summary: Takes an extract result and returns every sheet with its visibility and a count for each sheet-level kind, plus a count for each workbook-level kind and the full list of kinds. Zero counts are kept rather than dropped, so an empty kind shows as empty.

jobs: count each kind on one sheet
summary: Takes one sheet and returns its key, name, visibility and a count for every sheet-level kind, with zeros included. Visibility is null when the sheet does not state one.

jobs: make a name unique within a set
summary: Takes the set of names already used and a proposed name, and returns the name if it is free or the first free variant with a numeric suffix before its extension. The chosen name is added to the set, so the same name is never returned twice.

jobs: build the extract from the selection
cap each table at a row limit
record what was picked and what was left
summary: Takes an extract result, a pick of sheets and kinds, and options such as a row limit, title and timestamp, and returns the items for that pick with a record of what was taken and what was left. A pick with no sheet list takes every sheet and an empty kind list takes nothing, and a kind that finds nothing on a sheet gives no item rather than an empty one.

jobs: add one item from an extract part
cut rows to the row limit
summary: Takes a kind, the sheet it came from and one part, and appends an item to the extract. A text part is kept whole under its own extension, while a row part is cut to the row limit when one is set and marked with its total, and every item name is made unique within the extract.

jobs: list a workbook's sheets and objects
add the sheet survey to the object list
summary: Takes an extract result and returns the sheet survey together with a flat list of the workbook's objects: pivot tables, pivot caches that have rows, connections and data queries. Each object carries an id, kind, label, the sheet it belongs to where that sheet is listed, and a count.

jobs: add one pivot table to the object list
summary: Takes a pivot table and its position and adds it as an object labelled with its name or file name. It is placed on its sheet when that sheet is in the workbook, and its detail is the source the pivot reports.

jobs: add a pivot cache with rows
summary: Takes a pivot cache and its position and adds an object only when the cache holds rows. The object is labelled by its source range where known and placed on the source sheet when that sheet is in the workbook.

jobs: build an extract from per-sheet selections
add chosen workbook objects to the extract
record what was picked and left
summary: Takes an extract result, a selection in which each sheet names its own kinds, and a list of chosen objects, and returns an extract holding only those items. A kind a sheet does not hold is skipped, and each chosen pivot or data source contributes only its own row of the workbook-wide list.

jobs: add an item under a unique name
summary: Takes an item and an optional object and appends a copy of the item under a name that no other item holds. When an object is given, the copy records that object's id and sheet.

jobs: list kinds a sheet holds but left out
summary: Takes a sheet's counts and the kinds selected for it, and returns the sheet's name with each sheet-level kind it holds that the selection leaves out. Kinds with a zero count are not listed.

jobs: apply declared standing selections to a workbook
skip selections whose sheets are absent
list sheets that must not land
summary: Takes a workbook catalog and a list of declared standing selections, and returns the ones that apply: those whose named sheets are all present, or those that name no sheets. Each result gives the sheets to take with their readings, the sheets left out, the named sheets that must not land, and the row cap, which is null unless declared; the must-not-land names are returned for the caller to act on rather than removed here.

jobs: fill in a destination and file name
summary: Takes a declaration, the source workbook, a timestamp and an optional sheet name, and returns the destination and file name with the date, time, workbook name, lowercase name and sheet tokens filled in. With no file name declared, the file is named after the workbook with an extract JSON suffix.

jobs: publish the report layout functions on the page
summary: Runs once when the report kit loads, defining the helpers that build, read, draw and copy a report and publishing them on the page. It changes nothing else, and escaping comes from the shared escape function rather than a second copy.

jobs: list a field's values in display order
summary: Takes rows, a field name and an optional declared list, and returns the declared list when one is given. Otherwise it returns the distinct non-blank values of that field in the order they first appear.

jobs: build a report model from rows
add subtotal and total rows
summary: Takes a report spec and a list of rows and returns a plain model: the columns, each band crossed with each within value with a gap flagged where a band starts, the level names, and the rows in print order. The rows are an optional opening row, one row per distinct set of level labels, optional subtotals per group, and an optional total that sums the opening and subtotal values.

jobs: sum a measure per column across rows
summary: Takes a list of rows and returns the sum of the measure field for each band and within pair. Rows whose measure is not a number are skipped, so a missing value adds nothing rather than counting as zero.

jobs: format a number for a report cell
summary: Takes a value and a style and returns text: empty for a missing value, the plain number for the plain style, and otherwise the value rounded to a whole number with thousands separators.

jobs: group adjacent columns under their band
summary: Takes the columns of a report model and returns runs of consecutive columns that share a band, each with its name, its column count and whether a gap comes before it. The runs are used to draw the band header that spans each one.

jobs: add a column to its band run
summary: Takes the runs built so far and one column, and extends the last run when the column has the same band or starts a new run otherwise. Returns the runs list it was given.

jobs: convert a partition tree into a report model
add subtotal rows under each top group
order siblings by source position
summary: Takes a pivot partition result and options such as level names, separators, labels and sort order, and returns a report model of the same shape that build produces: a row per leaf, optional subtotal rows under each top-level group, and a total. Subtotals are withheld unless the partition is a sum or a count, so an average or maximum never prints a parent that is not the sum of its children.

jobs: split a column key into band and within
summary: Takes one column key and returns it with its band and within parts, splitting at the separator only when bands are in use. A column gets a gap before it when its band differs from the column before.

jobs: order a tree node's children
summary: Takes a tree node and returns its children, sorted by their source position when source order is asked for and every child has one. Otherwise the children come back in the tree's own order.

jobs: draw a report model as an html table
blank repeated labels down the row columns
summary: Takes a report model and an optional spec and returns table markup: a band header only where columns have bands, a column header row, then the rows, with subtotals shaded and the total ruled off. The table sits in a horizontally scrolling wrapper, and repeated label values are left blank so the hierarchy reads like a spreadsheet.

jobs: draw one report row as a table row
summary: Takes one row of the model and returns its table row markup. Item rows show their labels with repeats suppressed, subtotal and total rows show one bold label across the label columns, and every value is formatted and right-aligned, left empty when absent.

jobs: show a label only when it changes
summary: Takes a label value and its depth and returns a table cell that shows the value only where it differs from the one above it. A change at one depth clears the memory for every deeper depth, so a child label shows again under each new parent.

jobs: write a report as tab-separated text
summary: Takes a report model and returns it as tab-separated text: the band and column names first, then one line per row. Values are raw numbers rather than formatted text, so a paste lands as numbers, and a missing value is an empty field.

jobs: publish the csv helpers on the page
summary: Runs once when the csv kit loads and publishes a line parser, a row reader and helpers that split and join semicolon-separated lists. A blank list reads as no entries rather than one empty entry, and the separator can appear inside a value because it is escaped on the way out.

jobs: split one csv line into fields
summary: Takes one line of comma-separated text and returns its fields as strings. A quoted field may hold commas, a doubled quote stands for one quote character, and fields are not trimmed.

jobs: read csv text into keyed records
summary: Takes csv text whose first line is the header and returns one object per non-blank line, keyed by the trimmed header names with each value trimmed. A short line leaves its missing cells as empty strings, and empty input gives an empty list.

jobs: publish the row menu functions on the page
fetch the clipboard helper ahead of time
summary: Runs once when the row menu kit loads, fetching the clipboard helper early so that a copy runs inside the tap that asked for it, then publishes the menu, attach and copy functions on the page. If the helper is unavailable, copying falls back to the browser's own clipboard call.

jobs: build a dom element from parts
summary: Takes a tag name, an optional attribute map and any number of child nodes or lists, and returns a new element. A text attribute sets the element's text, attributes with null or false values are left off, and empty children are skipped.

jobs: list a table's visible data columns
summary: Takes a table and returns its visible columns that have a field, each with that field name and a title that falls back to the field name. Returns an empty list when the table cannot report its columns.

jobs: close the open row menu
summary: Takes no input and removes the open menu along with its document listeners and any row highlight. It does nothing when no menu is open, so calling it again is safe.

jobs: place a floating panel inside the window
summary: Takes an element and a requested x and y position, and attaches the element to the page moved so that it stays at least eight pixels inside the window edges. The element is hidden while it is measured, so it never shows at the origin first.

jobs: show a floating menu of actions
dismiss the menu on outside tap or scroll
summary: Takes a position, a list of labelled actions with optional icons, an optional row to highlight and a compact flag, and shows the menu there, closing any menu already open. It also closes on Escape, scrolling or resizing, returns a function that closes it, and shows nothing for an empty list.

jobs: run a menu action when it is chosen
summary: Takes no input of its own: when an item is tapped it runs that item's action and reports any failure as a failed result. A text result replaces the item's label briefly, a promise is waited for, and otherwise the menu closes unless the item is marked to stay open.

jobs: show an action result, then close the menu
summary: Takes a result text and, if the menu is still the one open, writes it onto the tapped item's label and closes the menu after about 0.7 seconds unless the item is marked to stay open. A menu that has already been replaced is left alone.

jobs: attach a row menu to a table
summary: Takes a table and options, and subscribes to its row taps so that each tap can open the row menu. It returns a function that closes any open menu and removes the subscription, and does nothing when the table cannot take listeners.

jobs: open a menu for a tapped row
copy the tapped row as tab-separated text
copy every visible row when several
summary: Takes a tap on a table row and, unless it landed on a control or the caller's skip rule applies, opens the menu at the pointer. The menu offers reading from that row onward when the record reader is loaded, copying the row with its headers, copying the rows still on screen when there is more than one, and any extra items the caller supplies.

jobs: publish the json viewer on the page
summary: Runs once when the viewer kit loads, fetching the clipboard helper early so that copying runs inside the tap, and publishes a schema analyser and a viewer on the page. Nothing is drawn until a viewer is mounted in a container.

jobs: build a dom element from parts
summary: Takes a tag name, an attribute map and child nodes, and returns a new element. An attribute named html sets markup, names beginning with on attach event listeners, null or false values are left off, and empty children are skipped.

jobs: format a byte count for display
summary: Takes a byte count and returns it in bytes, kilobytes or megabytes, with one decimal place for the larger units. A missing or non-numeric count gives an empty string.

jobs: describe a timestamp as time from now
summary: Takes a string and returns null unless it is a complete timestamp with a time zone. A valid one gives an object with a short relative phrase, such as 3h ago or in 2h, and the UTC time written out plainly.

jobs: profile the shape of a json value
infer columns of record lists
summary: Takes a parsed json value and returns its size in bytes, the node count, the deepest level, a count of each value type, the top-level entries, and a summary of each collection. For a list of records the summary includes each column's types, how often it is filled and a few sample values, and the size is measured on the JSON text.

jobs: count nodes and value types recursively
summary: Takes a value and its depth, adds one to the node count, tracks the deepest level, and tallies each value's type while recursing into lists and objects. It updates the enclosing counters and returns nothing.

jobs: summarize one inferred column
summary: Takes one inferred column and returns its name, the types seen in it joined with bars, the share of list items that fill it, and its sample values. A column with no recorded types reads as null.

jobs: build the viewer frame in a container
parse text input into data
summary: Takes a container and display options such as the data, the download name, the starting view and the starting path, and builds the viewer's state, toolbar and body inside it. Text input is parsed as JSON and kept as text when that fails, and the schema profile is worked out only when the schema view first needs it.

jobs: draw the viewer's current view
expose view, focus and search controls
summary: Finishes building the viewer by defining the raw view, the function that keeps the toolbar matched to the current view, and the render and navigation functions, then draws it once. It returns a control object with the profile, a way to change view or focus a path, a search update, and a destroy call that removes the viewer.

jobs: measure a value's size in bytes
summary: Takes a value and returns the number of UTF-8 bytes in its compact JSON form, or a character count when the encoder is unavailable. Object results are remembered, so the same collection is not serialised twice.

jobs: read the value at a path
summary: Takes a list of keys and indexes and returns the value found by following them from the loaded data, or undefined when a step is missing. Nothing is copied along the way.

jobs: turn a path into a readable key
summary: Takes a list of keys and indexes and returns one string in dotted and bracketed form, with the word root for an empty path. Numeric steps are shown in brackets, and the first step carries no leading dot.

jobs: describe a collection by its size
summary: Takes a value and returns a short count phrase for a collection, such as 3 items or 1 field, with a separate phrase for an empty one. A scalar value returns an empty string.

jobs: build an icon-only button with a tooltip
summary: Takes an icon name, a tooltip text and a click handler, and returns a small square button showing that icon, with the same text as its accessible label.

jobs: wait for typing to pause before filtering
summary: Takes an input event and restarts a 160 millisecond timer that passes the current text to the filter update. The filter therefore runs once typing pauses rather than on every keystroke.

jobs: collapse the tree to its top level
summary: Takes no input and clears every opened node and every show-more page count, then redraws, which returns the tree to its top level.

jobs: open the current rows as cards
load the card reader when first needed
summary: Takes a tap and opens the records at the current path in the card browser, loading that browser first if it is not yet on the page. A failure to load or open is written to the console and otherwise ignored.

jobs: flash a confirmation on a button
summary: Takes a button and an icon name and swaps the button's icon for a green check for about 1.2 seconds before restoring the original. It confirms a copy without adding a separate message.

jobs: download all loaded data as json
summary: Takes no input and saves all of the loaded data, not only the current path, as indented JSON under the given file name. The temporary download address is released as soon as the save starts.

jobs: filter the tree by a search term
summary: Takes a query text and marks every key or scalar value under the current path that contains it, along with the ancestors needed to reach each match, then redraws. An empty query clears the filter.

jobs: mark matching entries under a path
summary: Takes a value and its path, and recurses through its children recording each key or scalar whose text contains the query, along with the path of every ancestor below the starting point. It updates the match and ancestor sets and returns nothing.

jobs: display a text value in a row
link a web address
clamp long text until tapped
summary: Takes a string and returns its display element: a dim empty label for an empty string, a link opening in a new tab for a web address, the text with a relative time for a timestamp, and otherwise the text itself. A string longer than 140 characters or with line breaks shows three lines and expands or collapses when tapped.

jobs: summarize a record in one line
summary: Takes an object and returns a short line built from its first name-like field and its first detail field, joined with a separator. Arrays return an empty string.

jobs: pick the first usable field value
summary: Takes a list of key names and returns the value of the first one that holds a non-blank string or a number, with whitespace collapsed to single spaces. Returns an empty string when none qualifies.

jobs: display a value in a tree row
summary: Takes a value and whether it sits inside a list, and returns the element that shows it: null as a dim word, a string through the text display, a record in a list as its one-line summary, another collection as its size phrase, and any other value as plain text. The size phrase is set in the key's grey so it does not read as a second key.
